ingredients.name: black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg

steps.title: Make and chill the dough
steps.text: Mix crust ingredients in the mixer with the paddle until the dough just comes together. Chill.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: Roll into a 23 cm tart pan, line with parchment and weights, and bake. Remove the weights and bake 5 minutes more.

steps.title: Cook the bacon
steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp and drain it. Scatter it with the cheese in the crust.

steps.title: Add the custard and bake
steps.text: Whisk eggs, cream, milk, salt, pepper and nutmeg and pour over the filling. Bake until set with a slight wobble in the center. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

ingredients.name: black pepper and a pinch of nutmeg

steps.title: Cook the paste
steps.text: Bring milk, water, butter and salt to a boil. Add the flour at once and stir hard for 2 minutes until a ball forms.

steps.title: Beat in the eggs
steps.text: Move to the mixer and beat with the paddle on low to cool slightly. Add the eggs gradually until the paste is glossy. Mix in 90 g of the cheese, pepper and nutmeg.

steps.title: Pipe
steps.text: Pipe or spoon walnut-sized mounds onto lined trays and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake hot until puffed, then lower the heat until deep golden and crisp. Do not open the oven early. Serve warm.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Mix the sausage meat with the onion, breadcrumbs and thyme with your hands.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.text: Cut the pastry in half lengthwise. Pipe or shape the filling in a log along each strip, brush one edge with egg, and roll to seal with the seam underneath.

steps.title: Cut and glaze
steps.text: Cut each log into 8 pieces, place on a lined tray seam side down, brush with egg wash, and cut small slashes in the tops.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until deep golden and cooked through, at least 71 °C inside.

steps.title: Rub in the butter
steps.text: Mix flour, baking powder, salt and garlic powder in the mixer with the paddle on low. Add the butter until pea-sized pieces remain.

steps.title: Add cheese and milk
steps.text: Add the cheese and then the milk and mix for about 10 seconds, just until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Pat to 3 cm thick, cut into 8 rounds or squares, and place close together on a lined tray.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until tall and golden. Brush with melted butter.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Unfold the pastry, spread thinly with mustard, and sprinkle with half the cheese and the paprika. Fold over and roll lightly to seal.

steps.title: Cut and twist
steps.text: Cut into 1.5 cm strips and twist each strip a few times. Place on a lined tray.

steps.title: Glaze and bake
steps.text: Brush with egg wash, top with the remaining cheese, and bake until golden and crisp.
